import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Get the existing "docs" table
t = pxt.get_table("docs")

# Create the embedding UDF bound to the desired model
embed_fn = sentence_transformer.using(model_id="all-MiniLM-L6-v2")

# Add the embedding index needed for nearest-neighbor lookups on "content"
t.add_embedding_index("content", embedding=embed_fn)

# Query: 5 rows whose "content" is semantically closest to the query string
sim = t.content.similarity(string="climate change policy")
results = (
    t.select(t.content, similarity=sim)
    .order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .collect()
)

print(results)

import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

# Get the existing "docs" table
t = pxt.get_table("docs")

# Create the embedding UDF bound to the desired model
embed_fn = sentence_transformer.using(model_id="all-MiniLM-L6-v2")

# Add the embedding index needed for nearest-neighbor lookups on "content"
t.add_embedding_index("content", embedding=embed_fn)

# Query: 5 rows whose "content" is semantically closest to the query string
sim = t.content.similarity(string="climate change policy")
results = (
    t.select(t.content, similarity=sim)
    .order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .limit(5)
    .collect()
)

print(results)
